statements.markdown: Let $D(t)$ be smooth and trace free, with $D'+D^2$ symmetric. Then $Dx$ solves the Euler equations with pressure $-x\cdot(D'+D^2)x/2$. Choose a smooth odd $1$-periodic profile $F$ with $F'(0)=1$, and let $P'=F$, $\langle P\rangle_s=0$. Here $\langle H\rangle_s=\int_0^1H(s)\,\mathrm ds$ is the phase average.
